transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Let's get our pre-load coordination huddle started. We have three loads ready for movement to the support site during the 0700-1300 window: a clinic cold-chain pallet, a generator replacement pallet, and a routine administrative-supplies pallet. Our available transport is Trucks T-1, T-2, and T-3. Before I approve any vehicle assignments and loading sequence, I need transportation, maintenance control, and medical logistics to report any current handling or receiving requirements. Who wants to start?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Ma'am, during this morning's vehicle check I confirmed that only Truck T-2 has a functioning refrigerated-power inverter approved for the clinic cold-chain pallet. That equipment note hasn't been added to the movement worksheet yet, but the cold-chain pallet needs to go on T-2.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Ma'am, from maintenance control: I completed the axle inspection on Truck T-3 this morning. T-3 is currently limited to 2,500 kilograms, and the generator replacement pallet weighs 3,200 kilograms — so T-3 cannot carry the generator pallet. I need to note that this revised limitation hasn't been entered on the vehicle status board yet, but the inspection findings are confirmed.
